## Capacity check (read this before committing to dates)

PRD v2 plans **v1.0 GA in week 32** for one full-time developer with AI help, about **160 working days**. The P0–P5 tickets add up to **820.25 ideal dev-days**, roughly **5.1×** that capacity. Phase overlap does not create capacity for a single developer. Before scope freeze, choose one or more of: add a second developer (or a part-time contractor for infra, security and print layouts); cut SHOULD items from P1–P5 (public site, doctor discovery, dictation, voice assistant, clinic messages); launch one country only (ADR-002), which removes the UAE pack from the critical path; or move the GA date. Weeks over capacity are flagged ⚠ in [schedule.md](schedule.md). Estimates are ideal days and should be recalibrated against actual velocity after P0.
